scope: Observed return clearances for the sealed failed High film and prior native qualification.
method: Project full native pose/actor-box corners onto Road 67. The qualification comparison used its rounded ego-position journal. The rule requires 15 m ahead, 12 m behind, two seconds of headway and five seconds of closing time. All closing speeds use the observed 0.5 s directional vehicle motion. Other earlier controls could produce a different timing.
